marker_size_rule: A marker with no explicit size exports at the canvas' DEFAULT_MARKER_PX (5 px, sent as 5 pt), never the style preset's marker_size, the px-as-points rule an explicit width or marker size already follows. The preset value stays the backend default only for a request that names no size (an API or CLI caller).
line_width_rule: A line with no explicit width exports at the width the canvas draws it (the plot template's lineWidth, or the Preferences default line width under the Screen template; px sent as pt), never the style preset's line_width. The preset value stays the backend default only for a request that names no width (an API or CLI caller).
